maya (People Ops): @here quick heads-up — All-hands this Friday 9:30am PT. Primary focus: Safety policy updates + release playbook handoff. Agenda below, please drop any Qs you want addressed.

sanjay (Eng PM): Agenda draft: 1) Safety policy changes (15m) 2) Release playbook walkthrough (20m) 3) Region rollout & capacity plan (10m) 4) Open Qs / action owners (15m).

carl (CTO): Please skim the new Safety playbook before Friday: https://redwood.internal/docs/safety-playbook (TL;DR: stronger data handling rules for Private deployments and clearer masking rules for logs).

evie (Eng Ops): Recording + slide deck link will be posted to #all-hands-recordings and the Notion doc after the meeting. If you can't join, drop questions here and we'll surface them.

maya (People Ops): Tiny ask: if your team has a launch callout, add a 2-sentence summary + a single slide to the shared deck: https://bit.ly/rw-allhands-slides — please do this by Thu EOD so we can reorder.

sanjay (Eng PM): Q from infra: will Dedicated customers need config changes? Short answer: yes — we'll cover automated migration scripts, a canary path, and rollback instructions in the playbook walkthrough.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New draft playbook pushed: /playbooks/release_playbook_v2.md — reviewers: @sanjay @evie @carl please review comments.

evie (Eng Ops): Post-meeting takeaway plan: we'll open a 48-hour comment window on the Safety policy doc. After that window we freeze the doc for final sign-off and schedule a targeted sync for Dedicated migration runbooks.

carl (CTO): Heads-up callout: we will introduce an "emergency fallback" routing policy for spikes — it reduces unit cost under load but relaxes latency SLAs slightly. Ops will publish expected metrics and rollback criteria during the meeting.

maya (People Ops): :raised_hands: add any Qs here by Thursday EOD. I’ll synthesize and pass to execs for prep. If you want to be called out live for a 60s highlight, note it in the slide.

sanjay (Eng PM): If anyone wants a 2-min dry run for their callout, ping me — I can host 10m slots Thu 3:00–3:30pm PT.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Recording placeholder (will update after meeting): https://redwood.internal/recordings/1769997777-allhands.mp4
